gloss: a factual text that describes what a chart shows

gloss: one example that does not follow the usual rule
thai: กรณีพิเศษ
example: Two charts in one task are a special case: one overview, two headlines.

gloss: what usually happens or must happen
thai: กฎ
example: The rule is clear: every body sentence carries a number.

gloss: what is usual or expected
thai: บรรทัดฐาน
example: Rising sales were the norm in all five cities.

gloss: following the order just given
thai: ตามลำดับนั้น
example: The figures for Paris, Rome and Hanoi were 10, 20 and 30, in that order.

gloss: one after another, in order
thai: ทีละอย่างตามลำดับ
example: Describe the two groups each in turn, Group A first.

gloss: in a way that matches something else
thai: อย่างสอดคล้องกัน
example: Prices rose, and sales fell correspondingly.

gloss: without a fixed order
thai: ไม่เรียงลำดับ
example: You may check the Ten Wards in any order, but the same order every time is safer.

gloss: without a plan or pattern
thai: อย่างสุ่ม
example: Do not choose figures randomly; choose the key features.

gloss: without choosing carefully
thai: อย่างไม่เลือก
example: Listing figures indiscriminately makes a report mechanical.

gloss: one part of a total
thai: ส่วนแบ่ง
example: Coal's share of electricity fell to 20%.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words name the complete amount.

gloss: an amount shown as part of 100
thai: ร้อยละ
example: The percentage of homes with internet rose to 60%.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words name a complete amount or a plain count.

gloss: a piece of something bigger
thai: ส่วน
example: A large part of the budget went on food.

gloss: a part of something
thai: ส่วนหนึ่ง
example: A small portion of the land was used for farming.

gloss: one of the parts that something is divided into
thai: ส่วนย่อย
example: The largest segment of the pie is food.

gloss: formed a part of a total
thai: ประกอบเป็น
example: Students made up a third of all visitors.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words mean keeping something outside a total.

gloss: made or became a part of something
thai: ก่อตัวเป็น
example: Older people formed the largest group of users.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words mean keeping something outside a total.

gloss: was equal to a part of a total
thai: คิดเป็น เป็นตัวแทน
example: Online shopping represented a quarter of all sales.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words mean keeping something outside a total.

gloss: a position in a list from highest to lowest
thai: อันดับ
example: Japan held first rank in the table for every year.
antNote: Not an opposite: these words name things that go up and down instead of across.

gloss: one level of something that has several levels
thai: ระดับชั้น
example: The top tier of countries all had figures above 80%.
antNote: Not an opposite: these words name things that go up and down instead of across.

gloss: a tall thin upright shape
thai: เสา
example: Each bar stood like a pillar above the year.
antNote: Not an opposite: these words name things that go across, not up.

gloss: a pile of things one on top of another
thai: กอง
example: A stacked bar puts each part in a stack on top of the others.
antNote: Not an opposite: these words name things laid out side by side.

gloss: one action in a series of actions
thai: ขั้น
example: The first step is to collect the plastic bottles.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words name the complete process, not one step.

gloss: one part of a process or of a period
thai: ระยะ
example: In the second phase, the sugar is dried and packed.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words name the complete process, not one part.

gloss: a particular point in a process or time
thai: จุดเวลาหนึ่ง
example: At this juncture, the liquid is poured into moulds.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words name the complete process.

gloss: the verb form that puts the action before the doer
thai: กริยารูปถูกกระทำ
example: The passive voice suits a process: the beans are roasted.

gloss: be + past participle, such as "is made"
thai: รูปถูกกระทำ
example: Use the passive form for every man-made stage.

gloss: a sentence built with the passive
thai: โครงสร้างประโยคถูกกระทำ
example: "The bridge was built in 1990" is a passive construction.

gloss: the verb form where the subject does the action
thai: รูปประธานเป็นผู้กระทำ
example: Natural stages stay in the active: the eggs hatch.

gloss: the verb form where the doer is the subject
thai: กริยารูปผู้กระทำ
example: The active voice suits a life cycle: the frog lays eggs.

gloss: a verb used so that the subject does the action
thai: รูปประโยคผู้กระทำ
example: "Rain falls" uses the active form, because nature does it.

gloss: going in one line, without turning
thai: ตรง
example: The process goes in a straight line from wood to paper.

gloss: going in only one direction
thai: ทางเดียว
example: Making bricks is a one-way process: it never returns to clay.

gloss: following one after another in order
thai: ตามลำดับขั้น
example: The diagram shows six sequential stages.

gloss: going round and returning to the start
thai: เป็นวงกลม
example: The water cycle is circular: it has no first or last stage.

gloss: happening again and again
thai: ซ้ำไปซ้ำมา
example: The life cycle shows a repeating pattern of four stages.

gloss: happening again many times
thai: เกิดขึ้นซ้ำ
example: A recurring dip appears every winter on the graph.

gloss: destroyed a building on purpose
thai: ถูกทุบทิ้ง
example: The old cinema was knocked down in 2005.

gloss: knocked a building down
thai: ถูกรื้อลง
example: The houses near the river were pulled down.

gloss: completely destroyed a building or town
thai: ถูกทำลายราบ
example: The old factory was razed to make space for a park.

gloss: made a building or road
thai: ถูกสร้าง
example: A new hospital was built to the north of the lake.

gloss: built something
thai: ถูกก่อสร้าง
example: A car park was constructed next to the station.

gloss: built or put up something tall
thai: ถูกตั้งขึ้น
example: A new tower was erected in the city centre.

gloss: increased in size
thai: ถูกทำให้ใหญ่ขึ้น
example: The car park was made bigger in 2010.

gloss: made larger
thai: ถูกขยายให้ใหญ่ขึ้น
example: The airport was enlarged to the south.

gloss: grew or was made larger
thai: ถูกขยายตัว
example: The town expanded eastwards over the period.

gloss: reduced in size
thai: ถูกทำให้เล็กลง
example: The park was made smaller to fit a new road.

gloss: made less or smaller
thai: ถูกลดลง
example: The forest was reduced to half its size.

gloss: made smaller than planned or than before
thai: ถูกลดขนาด
example: The shopping centre was scaled back to two floors.

gloss: became, or was changed to, something new
thai: กลายเป็น
example: The old station was turned into a museum.

gloss: became something different
thai: เปลี่ยนเป็น
example: The field was changed into a sports ground.

gloss: completely changed
thai: ถูกเปลี่ยนโฉม
example: The harbour area was transformed into shops and cafés.

gloss: let something stay as it was
thai: ถูกเก็บไว้
example: The old church was kept and is still in use.

gloss: not changed at all
thai: ถูกปล่อยไว้ตามเดิม
example: The lake was left as it was on both maps.

gloss: kept in its original state
thai: ถูกอนุรักษ์ไว้
example: The historic market was preserved in the town plan.

gloss: not different
thai: เหมือนเดิม
example: The figure for 2020 was the same as for 2010.

gloss: not changed in any way
thai: ไม่ถูกแก้ไขเปลี่ยนแปลง
example: The road layout in the south remained unaltered.

gloss: made different
thai: เปลี่ยนไปแล้ว
example: The changed area is now a large car park.

gloss: not the same
thai: แตกต่าง
example: The two charts measure different things.

gloss: changed in some way
thai: ถูกปรับเปลี่ยน
example: The altered road now goes around the lake.

gloss: the most important idea
thai: ประเด็นหลัก
example: The main point of the chart is the rise in online sales.

gloss: an important idea
thai: ประเด็นสำคัญ
example: Each key point in the overview has no figures.

gloss: the general meaning of something
thai: ใจความสำคัญ
example: The overview gives the gist of the chart in two sentences.

gloss: a small note at the bottom of a page
thai: เชิงอรรถ
example: The footnote says that the figures are in thousands.

gloss: small details that are easy to miss
thai: รายละเอียดปลีกย่อย
example: Read the fine print under the chart: the units may be millions.

gloss: put or come together
thai: เชื่อม รวม
example: Join two short sentences with which.

gloss: join together to become one
thai: ผสานรวม
example: Two small towns merged into one large one on the second map.

gloss: join to form one bigger thing
thai: รวมเข้าด้วยกัน
example: The two schools were amalgamated in 2015.

gloss: keep apart or divide
thai: แยกออก
example: Separate the data into two groups before you write.

gloss: divide into parts
thai: แบ่ง
example: Split the five lines into two groups.

gloss: separate one thing from the others
thai: แยกออกมาเดี่ยวๆ
example: Isolate the one category that breaks the pattern.

gloss: the one that comes before all the others
thai: อันแรก
example: Of the two cities, the first had more visitors.

gloss: the thing named just earlier
thai: อันก่อนหน้า
example: Compare each year with the one before.

gloss: the thing already named earlier in the text
thai: ที่กล่าวมาแล้ว
example: The aforementioned rise was the largest on the graph.

gloss: the one that comes after the first
thai: อันที่สอง
example: The second country had a much lower figure.

gloss: the one that comes after all the others
thai: อันสุดท้าย
example: Of Paris, Rome and Vienna, the last had the lowest sales.

gloss: the thing named most recently
thai: สิ่งที่กล่าวถึงล่าสุด
example: Tea and coffee both rose; the last-mentioned rose faster.

gloss: done without thinking
thai: อัตโนมัติ
example: Checking the units should become automatic.

gloss: doing or saying the same thing many times
thai: ซ้ำซาก
example: "Then it rose, then it rose" is repetitive; vary the verbs.

gloss: following a fixed pattern without fresh thought
thai: ตามสูตรสำเร็จ
example: A memorised report sounds formulaic and may not fit the chart.

gloss: showing careful thinking
thai: รอบคอบ
example: A thoughtful report chooses the key features.

gloss: normal and not forced
thai: เป็นธรรมชาติ
example: Natural links point back with this or the latter.

gloss: the most important or interesting part
thai: จุดเด่น
example: The highlight of the chart is the crossover in 2016.

gloss: a feature that is most noticeable and important
thai: ลักษณะเด่นสำคัญ
example: The salient feature is the sharp fall in coal use.

gloss: a small, less important fact
thai: ประเด็นรอง
example: The small dip in 2014 is only a minor point.

gloss: small facts that are not important
thai: เรื่องจุกจิก
example: Leave out trivia such as every small change.

gloss: right, with no mistakes
thai: ถูกต้อง
example: Check that every preposition with a number is correct.

gloss: perfect, with no faults
thai: ไร้ที่ติ
example: A flawless report is rare; aim for most sentences error-free.

gloss: not correct
thai: ผิด
example: The Whisper gave the wrong year for the peak.

gloss: having a mistake or not working properly
thai: บกพร่อง
example: A faulty sentence beats no sentence, but a correct one beats both.

gloss: having a fault that makes it weaker
thai: มีข้อบกพร่อง
example: The overview was flawed because it contained a figure.

gloss: to the same amount
thai: ในปริมาณเท่ากัน
example: The four criteria count in equal measure.

gloss: not equally
thai: อย่างไม่เท่ากัน
example: Rainfall was spread unevenly across the year.

gloss: in a way that is not the same
thai: อย่างแตกต่าง
example: The two age groups behaved differently over the period.

gloss: too much or too little compared with something else
thai: อย่างไม่ได้สัดส่วน
example: Young people were disproportionately affected by the change.

gloss: the place where two things meet
thai: จุดบรรจบ
example: The meeting point of the two lines is in 2016.

gloss: the place where one line crosses another
thai: จุดตัด
example: After the crossing point, online sales stayed higher.

gloss: the point where two lines cross
thai: จุดตัดกัน
example: The intersection of the two lines marks the year they were equal.

gloss: the process of moving further apart
thai: การแยกห่างออกจากกัน
example: The divergence between the two lines grew after 2010.

gloss: show clearly
thai: แสดงให้เห็นชัดเจน
example: The figures demonstrate a clear rise over the decade.

gloss: be a typical example of something
thai: เป็นตัวอย่าง
example: The figures for Hanoi exemplify the rising group.

gloss: make something hard to see or understand
thai: บดบัง
example: Too many figures obscure the main trend.

gloss: get ready for something
thai: เตรียม
example: Prepare two groups before you start the details.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words mean starting without getting ready.

gloss: put things into a clear order
thai: จัดระเบียบ
example: Organise the data into two groups before you write.

gloss: plan something in detail
thai: วางแผนอย่างละเอียด
example: Map out your four paragraphs in the first four minutes.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words mean starting without a plan.

gloss: do something without planning it first
thai: ทำแบบด้นสด
example: Do not improvise the overview; plan it first.

gloss: do something without preparing (informal)
thai: ทำไปตามสถานการณ์
example: Students who wing it often forget the overview.

gloss: write something again in a different way
thai: เขียนใหม่
example: Rewrite the task sentence in your own words for the introduction.

gloss: say something again using different words
thai: เรียบเรียงใหม่
example: Rephrase "shows the number of" as "illustrates how many".

gloss: change the words but keep the meaning
thai: ใช้ถ้อยคำใหม่
example: Reword the task sentence; never copy eight words in a row.

gloss: the exact details of something
thai: รายละเอียดเฉพาะ
example: The specifics, such as each figure, belong in paragraphs three and four.

gloss: small facts and details
thai: ข้อมูลปลีกย่อย
example: The table gives the particulars for each of the five countries.

gloss: a short summary of the main points
thai: เรื่องย่อ
example: The overview is like a synopsis of the whole chart.
antNote: No exact opposite: these words name the long, detailed version.

gloss: have the same opinion as someone
thai: เห็นด้วยกับ
example: The figures agree with the trend in the overview.
